title: 第1101章 一半圣体本源第1100章 暗魂陷阱
slug: 修真废柴我的系统有点猛
lines: “人族小子，你…很不错！真是让老朽开了眼界！
数万载悠悠岁月，我族耗尽心血，苦苦等待的那个能彻底终结这场灾劫的‘有缘人’，竟是一位人族！”
姚德龙瞳孔骤然收缩！世界投影之力瞬间锁定声音来源！
只见在前方古道尽头，那片最为浓稠的混沌阴影中心，一团无法用言语形容其瑰丽与威严的火焰，缓缓浮现！
这团火焰，流淌着万火归宗的无上道韵，其核心仿佛蕴含着开天辟地之初的第一缕火种！
它仅仅是存在着，就让姚德龙体内的大日神焱和琉璃薪火都为之悸动、臣服！
始祖狐火！超越了神火，近乎达到本源层次的始祖之火！
“前辈是？”姚德龙心神剧震，瞬间明白了许多，沉声问道。
那蕴含着始祖意志的火团微微摇曳，苍老的神念波动再次传来，带着沉重的叹息：
“此地，万狐山禁地，实则是上古之时，我天狐一族联合其他大能，与混沌莽族在此展开的最终决战之地！
那场大战，打得天崩地裂，最终虽将混沌莽族主力镇压，
但其族中最为诡异难缠的‘暗魂本源’，却无法彻底泯灭，只能以九重封印将其层层禁锢于此！”
“你所经历的前八重考验，焚心桥、骨林、燃魂谷、万火归宗殿、化生池、本源火海、焚天古道……
其核心目的，并非筛选传承者，而是借助后辈天骄的力量和进入时携带的天地精气，
不断加固、补充这九重封印！而每一重考验之地‘坐化’的先祖遗骸，
其残魂，最终都自愿投入封印核心，化为削弱暗魂本源的薪柴！”
姚德龙倒吸一口冷气！真相竟是如此惨烈悲壮！天狐族历代天骄前仆后继进入禁地，
竟是为了用生命和灵魂加固这守护族群的封印！这份沉甸甸的责任与牺牲，令人肃然起敬！
“前辈言我乃有缘人，不知是何意？”姚德龙压下心绪，问出最关键的问题。
始祖狐火的意志变得无比郑重：“这暗魂本源，如同附骨之疽，寻常力量根本无法彻底炼化！
唯有其克星——蕴含了‘万火之源’潜质的力量，方有可能将其彻底焚成虚无！
而你，人族小子，你的大日圣体，你的大日神焱，正是具备这等至高‘源’之属性的无上道火！”
“然而……”始祖狐火的声音带上了一丝凝重与歉意，
“要彻底催动这炼化之力，需要极其庞大的‘源’之能量作为引子与薪柴……需要你，献出大日圣体一半的本源精血！”
一半本源！
这等同于剜心割肉！大日圣体乃姚德龙立足之本，根基所在！
损失一半本源，轻则修为倒退，圣体受损，潜力大减；重则根基崩溃，道途断绝！这代价，沉重的难以想象！
“老夫知道，这要求何其过分！但……时不我待！”
始祖狐火的意志充满了急迫，“这封印历经数万年侵蚀，历代先祖残魂前仆后继地修补，早已是千疮百孔！
老夫推演，最多再有三百年，暗魂本源必将彻底冲破封印！
届时，这些吞噬了无数天狐先祖残魂的暗魂回归混沌莽族，必将催生出难以想象的恐怖存在！
天狐族首当其冲，必然灭族！而以此为跳板，整个妖域，乃至苍云世界，都将陷入无边浩劫！”
姚德龙沉默了。
古道内，死一般的寂静。只有世界投影的力量依旧在运转，压制着残余的混沌阴影。
始祖狐火的意志带着忐忑与希冀，静静等待着这位人族的抉择。
这关乎一族乃至一界的命运，重若万钧！
仅仅数息之后。
姚德龙缓缓抬起头，那双深邃的眼眸中，没有恐惧，没有犹豫，只有一片澄澈的决然与坚定！
他望向那团代表了天狐族无上荣耀与悲怆牺牲的始祖之火，嘴角甚至勾起一抹洒脱的弧度，声音铿锵有力，掷地有声：
content_en:
"Human boy, you are... very good! It really opened my eyes!
For tens of thousands of years, our clan has exhausted its efforts and has been waiting for the ‘destined person’ who can completely end this disaster, but it is actually a human! "
Yao Delong's pupils suddenly shrank! The power of world projection instantly locks the source of the sound!
At the end of the ancient road ahead, in the center of the densest shadow of chaos, a flame whose beauty and majesty cannot be described in words slowly emerged!
This flame flows with the supreme Tao charm of all fires returning to the clan, and its core seems to contain the first ray of fire at the beginning of the world!
Just by its existence, the Great Sun Divine Flame and Glaze Fire in Yao Delong's body throbbed and surrendered!
The ancestral fox fire! It surpassed the divine fire and almost reached the original level of the ancestral fire!
"Who is the senior?" Yao Delong's heart was shaken, and he understood a lot in an instant, and asked in a deep voice.
The fire ball containing the will of the ancestors swayed slightly, and the fluctuations of the old spiritual thoughts came again, with a heavy sigh:
"This place, the Forbidden Land of Wanhu Mountain, is actually the place where our Tianhu Clan, together with other great powers, fought the final decisive battle with the Chaos Mang Clan in ancient times!
That battle was so violent that although the main force of the Chaos Mang Clan was finally suppressed,
However, the most bizarre and difficult 'dark soul origin' among his clan cannot be completely eliminated. It can only be imprisoned here layer by layer with nine layers of seals! "
"The first eight tests you have experienced are the Burning Heart Bridge, the Bone Forest, the Burning Soul Valley, the Ten Thousand Fires Returning Clan Hall, the Metamorphosis Pond, the Origin Sea of Fire, and the Burning Heaven Ancient Road...
Its core purpose is not to select successors, but to use the power of the descendants and the essence of heaven and earth they carry when entering,
Constantly strengthen and replenish these nine seals! And the remains of the ancestors who were ‘sitting’ in each place of trial,
Their remaining souls were eventually voluntarily thrown into the core of the seal and turned into firewood that weakened the origin of the dark soul! "
Yao Delong took a breath of air! The truth is so tragic and tragic! The Tianhu clan’s geniuses of all generations entered the forbidden area one after another.
It was actually to use life and soul to strengthen the seal that protects the ethnic group! This heavy responsibility and sacrifice is awe-inspiring!
"Senior said that I am a destined person, what do you mean?" Yao Delong suppressed his emotions and asked the most critical question.
The will of the ancestor Fox Fire became extremely solemn: "The origin of this dark soul is like gangrene attached to the bone, and ordinary power cannot be completely refined!
Only its nemesis - the power that contains the potential of the 'source of all fires' - can completely burn it into nothingness!
And you, the human boy, your Holy Body of the Great Sun, your divine flame of the Great Sun, are the supreme fire with the attributes of the supreme ‘source’! "
"However..." Ancestor Fox Fire's voice was filled with a hint of solemnity and apology.
"To fully activate this refining power, an extremely large amount of 'source' energy is needed as a primer and firewood... I need you to donate half of the original essence and blood of the Holy Body of the Sun!"
Half the origin!
This is equivalent to cutting out the heart and cutting out the flesh! The Holy Body of the Great Sun is the basis and foundation of Yao Delong!
Losing half of your origin will mean that your cultivation will regress, your holy body will be damaged, and your potential will be greatly reduced; at worst, your foundation will collapse and your path will be cut off! The price is unimaginably heavy!
"I know this is too much to ask for! But... time waits for no one!"
The will of the ancestor Fox Fire was full of urgency, "This seal has been eroded for tens of thousands of years, and the remnant souls of the ancestors of the past generations have repaired it one after another, and it is already riddled with holes!
According to my deduction, in another three hundred years at most, the origin of the Dark Soul will completely break through the seal!
By then, these dark souls that have devoured the remnant souls of countless Sky Fox ancestors will return to the Chaos Mang Clan, and will surely give birth to unimaginable terrifying existences!
The Tianhu clan is the first to bear the brunt and will inevitably be exterminated! And using this as a springboard, the entire Demon Realm and even Cangyun World will fall into boundless catastrophe! "
Yao Delong was silent.
Inside the ancient road, there was deathly silence. Only the power of world projection is still operating, suppressing the remaining shadows of chaos.
The will of the ancestor Fox Fire was filled with anxiety and hope, quietly waiting for this human race's decision.
This is about the fate of a clan and even an entire world, and it is as important as anything!
After just a few breaths.
Yao Delong slowly raised his head. In his deep eyes, there was no fear or hesitation, only a clear determination and determination!
He looked at the ancestral fire that represented the Supreme Glory and tragic sacrifice of the Sky Fox Clan. The corner of his mouth even curled up with a free and easy arc, and his voice was sonorous, powerful and resounding:
